transcript: If cookies are your love language, here's the recipe for the best brown butter chocolate chip cookies of all time. Start by putting 3 quarters of cup of butter on low heat on the stove. First it'll start to bubble up like this and eventually it'll turn this beautiful golden brown color. Take it off the heat then add in 1 cup of brown sugar and 1 quarter cup of white sugar. Mix that until just combined then add in 1 large egg yolk, a whole egg, and a tablespoon of vanilla. This is 3 times as much vanilla as normal and I promise you it's worth it. Then add in 1 and 3 quarter cups of spoon and level all-purpose flour, 3 quarter teaspoon baking soda, and 1 teaspoon salt. Mix this until just combined then add in 2 cups of semi-sweet chocolate chips or 8 ounces of chopped chocolate. From there scoop your cookie dough into 2 ounce balls, roll them between your hands, then I like to do this trick where you add a few more pieces of chocolate to the top of each cookie. Then you need to chill these cookies for at least 30 minutes. This really helps them to deepen in flavor and leads to a better texture. Cover them, place them in the fridge, then when you're ready bake it 350 for 11 to 12 minutes. Always top your cookies with a little sea salt and that is it. Best chocolate chip cookies you'll ever eat.
